approach: Count the rejected, failed or timed-out jobs in one retry lineage (a chain of "try again on <job>" requests) from the job records. The count is built on `job_history` and `retries_by_job` in `crates/athena-core/src/reading/retry.rs`, with a named constant `LINEAGE_ATTEMPT_LIMIT = 3`. A new `lineage_stop` returns None when the job is in no lineage or has fewer than 3 failed attempts. Otherwise it returns the failed job ids, the findings and unmet criteria seen in at least two attempts, and a `NarrowerAction`: Queued(existing marker request), Queue(text of a new narrower request) or Refused(reason). The narrower request is defined mechanically, not as a renamed retry. Its title is `Re-scope or split <root>: <first repeated item>`. Its acceptance bullets are only the repeated unmet criteria and one bullet per repeated blocker/major finding, capped strictly below the root's own bullet count when the root has more than one. Leftover repeated items go in the body under "Left for a later request". Its files are the files named in the repeated findings' locations, kept to the root's files when they overlap, then the root's files, then the fallback `StewardRequest::from_change` already uses. A request that is itself a narrower request (its title starts `Re-scope or split `) never gets another: `lineage_stop` returns Refused, the drain still stops, and the operator decides. The drain asks through two new `Steps` methods with defaults, so no existing implementor changes. It asks at two places in `Drain::attempts`: (1) the loop top, before `run_job`, for a non-landing attempt (stops a queued retry item whose chain already holds 3 failures, and a 4th attempt after any failure); (2) right after `failures += 1`, before the `failures >= ATTEMPTS` return (a lineage that reaches 3 on the item's own last in-run attempt would otherwise end `Failed` with nothing recorded). A hand `athena retry` stays unlimited. A new `lineage-limit` default is added to `defaults.toml`. The reader token budget (1997 of 2000) has no room, so `buy-first` is split at its real `; ` break (59 bytes saved, estimate by count) and the new entry's first sentence and id are worded and measured so the computed reader size stays exactly 1997. `docs/system-facts.md` and `docs/design/context-engineer.md` are then not touched, and they are not deliverables. Tests use `max_jobs` of at least 2 so the job cap cannot be the thing that stops the 4th attempt, and each stop point is shown by removing it.

decisions.choice: Ask `Steps::lineage_stop` at two points in `Drain::attempts` (drain.rs:1855-1957) through one helper `Drain::lineage_end(item, job) -> Option<ItemEnd>`. Point 1: in the `if passed.is_none()` block after the `paused_reason` check (1875-1877) and before `run_job` (1887), with `last_job`. Point 2: right after `failures += 1` (1941), only when `passed.is_none()` and `paused_reason(item)` is None, before the `failures >= ATTEMPTS` block (1942). The helper calls `lineage_stop`, then `queue_narrower` (skipped for Refused), writes one `drain      <item> stopped: ...` UI line plus a `note_once`, and returns `ItemEnd::LineageStopped(reason)`; `finish` passes the item over with the reason.
decisions.reason: Point 1 covers a queued retry item whose chain is already at 3 and any retry after a failure. Point 2 covers the lineage that becomes 3 on the item's last in-run attempt: there `failures` becomes 2 and the function returns `Failed` (1951-1954) at once, so point 1 never sees it and no narrower request would be queued. Point 1 alone would not do it, and point 2 alone misses a queued item already at 3 before its first read. The pause keeps priority, so the scope guard's own stop is unchanged. A landing retry of a passed job (`passed.is_some()`) is not a new attempt and is not checked.

decisions.choice: `lineage_attempts(records, job)` in retry.rs calls `job_history` once and derives the forward map with a private `retries_in(records, &history)` that `retries_by_job` is changed to call (same result). It returns empty at once when the given job has no `retry_of` and no entry in the forward map. Otherwise it walks forward to the newest standing retry, then back along `retry_of`, with a seen-set and `MAX_RETRY_DEPTH` each way, and keeps jobs whose `records.jobs[id].state()` is Closed(Rejected | Failed | TimedOut), oldest first. `pub const LINEAGE_ATTEMPT_LIMIT: usize = 3`.

decisions.choice: The replacement is an ordinary request built by `StewardRequest::new` and queued with `Athena::queue` (channel `cli`). Narrowing rule, mechanical. Title: `Re-scope or split <root id>: <first repeated item, one line, at most 80 characters>`. Body: starts `Lineage <root id>: failed attempts <ids>.`, then the repeated findings (one line each, length-capped), and, under `Left for a later request:`, any repeated items that did not fit the acceptance. Acceptance: one bullet per repeated unmet criterion (`Meet: <criterion>`) and per repeated blocker/major finding (`Resolve: <summary>`), at most max(1, root bullets - 1) of them when the root has more than one bullet; never the root's full list. A finding repeats when the same summary+location (or the same unmet criterion text) is in at least 2 failed attempts; a failed attempt with no verification contributes its closing reason line. If nothing repeats, the last attempt's blocking findings are used and the body says none repeated. Files: (1) paths from the repeated findings' `location` (trailing `:line[:col]` stripped, `looks_like_path`), restricted to the root's `request_text_touches` when that overlap is non-empty; (2) else the root's touches; (3) else `records/`, the fallback `StewardRequest::from_change` already uses (steward.rs:624-630). `lineage_stop` finds an existing request job whose text contains `Lineage <root id>:` and returns Queued(it), so later passes queue nothing. Second generation: if the lineage root's own request starts with `Re-scope or split `, the action is Refused and nothing is queued.
decisions.reason: `StewardRequest::new` checks the text against the parse `athena plan` uses (steward.rs:532-592), so the planning pass never refuses it for missing acceptance, and it demands at least one bullet and one path (560-567), which the three-step files fallback guarantees. The narrowing is checkable: acceptance differs from the root's text and is no larger than its bullet count, strictly smaller when the root has several. The second-generation stop closes the loop that a fresh lineage at zero would otherwise open: a narrower request that itself fails 3 times is passed over for the operator and not re-narrowed forever. `queue` redacts and commits a Request record on the already-drained `cli` channel. No new record type, so `check_record_file` and `AnyRecord` are untouched.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs `mod tests` (helpers `records_with`, `outcome`, `finding`, `two_majors_and_a_minor`) build in-memory `Records` with a chain j1 <- j2 <- j3 of "try again on" requests. They assert: `LINEAGE_ATTEMPT_LIMIT == 3`; `lineage_attempts` returns the failed ids oldest first from any job of the chain and from an unrun queued item that retries j3; a landed job, a dropped or stale retry and a job in another lineage are not counted; rejected, failed and timed-out each count; a job in no lineage returns empty; a cyclic request does not loop; `retries_by_job` returns the same map as before for the same records.
demonstrations.observes: The constant is 3, and the count over the `job_history`/`retries_in` chain matches the records for each shape. The constant and helper are visible in the diff of retry.rs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the helper the test module does not compile. With a counting bug (stale counted, forward walk missing, queued item not walking back) one shape assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Two tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, over `drain::drain(&real_steps(&athena, &lander), limits, &Lines)` with a `Scenario` whose verdict is `fail` with every criterion met and one major finding `the description lists no callers` (a Fail verdict or blocking finding gives final_verdict Fail, verify.rs:649-672; no unmet criterion, so the scope guard's T4 does not pause). In-item path `a_lineage_with_three_rejected_attempts_gets_no_fourth_attempt`: run j1 by hand to Rejected; `athena.retry(j1)` and run it to Rejected j2; `athena.queue("try again on <j2>")` = q. Drain with `max_jobs: 3`. The drain reads and runs q (3rd failure). Assert: j1, j2 and q are `JobState::Closed(OutcomeState::Rejected)`; `lineage_attempts(&records, q)` is exactly [j1, j2, q]; no request job has text `try again on <q>`; `steps.paused(&[q])` is empty; the lander landed nothing for q; the `plan       <q> passed over:` line (or the item's `drain      <q> stopped:` line) names the lineage stop; and no output line says `over the job limit` for q. Loop-top path `a_queued_retry_of_a_lineage_with_three_failures_is_not_read_or_run`: hand-reject j1, j2 (`athena.retry`) and j3 (`athena.retry(j2)`), then `athena.queue("try again on <j3>")` = q; drain with `max_jobs: 3`. Assert q is still `JobState::Queued` (never read or run), no job of q's own exists, no job has text `try again on <q>`, and the passed-over line names the lineage. Planning may read q, so the Reader count is not asserted.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly three rejected jobs in the lineage and none a retry of the third, with `max_jobs` 3 so the cap could not have stopped it; the output says the lineage was stopped. The sibling command `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain a_queued_retry_of_a_lineage_with_three_failures_is_not_read_or_run` shows a queued 4th is not dispatched either.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without point 1 (loop top), after q fails the loop calls `run_job(ReadOf::Retry(q))`; started is 1 < 3, so it makes and runs a job `try again on <q>`: the no-retry-of-q assertion and the lineage-equals-3 assertion fail. Without point 1 in the queued-retry test, q is read and run and closes, so the Queued assertion fails. Step 12 removes each point in turn to confirm.

demonstrations.method: Three tests. (a) `the_lineage_stop_queues_one_narrower_request_that_carries_the_repeated_findings` on the in-item fixture of criterion 3: load `Records`; select requests whose text contains `Lineage <j1>:`. Assert exactly one, on channel `cli`, text not starting `try again on`, starting its title `Re-scope or split `, containing `the description lists no callers` and the three failed job ids, `request_text_acceptance` non-empty, its bullet count no larger than the root request's (strictly smaller when the root has several) and none equal to a root bullet, and its `Files:` inside the root's touches. Then call `steps.lineage_stop(q)` and `steps.queue_narrower(&stop)` on the same `RealSteps` and assert the returned id is the queued one and `fx.head()` is unchanged. (b) `a_lineage_that_reaches_three_failures_on_the_items_second_attempt_queues_the_narrower_request`: hand-reject j1, queue `try again on <j1>` = q, drain with `max_jobs: 2`. q runs (2nd failure), its retry r runs (3rd); point 2 stops before the `failures >= ATTEMPTS` return. Assert: exactly one marker request; the output does not contain `failed twice`; no job retries r; the passed-over line names the lineage. (c) `a_queued_retry_of_a_lineage_with_three_failures_is_not_read_or_run` (criterion 3 fixture) drains twice and asserts one marker request after both and q still Queued. (d) core unit tests in reading.rs: a finding in 2 of 3 attempts is listed, one in 1 is not, the `none repeated` wording, a root with no files and no located findings still builds a request (files `records/`), the request is accepted by `request_text_acceptance`/`request_text_touches`, the marker lookup returns Queued, and a lineage whose root request is itself a `Re-scope or split ` request gives Refused and queues nothing.
demonstrations.observes: One narrower, differently-worded request carries the repeated finding; a direct second queue call adds none; a second full drain adds none (case c, where the stopped item is still queued so the stop is re-checked). Sibling commands: `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain a_lineage_that_reaches_three_failures_on_the_items_second_attempt_queues_the_narrower_request` and `cargo test -p athena-core lineage_stop`.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without queuing, the marker count of 1 fails. Without the marker lookup, the second `queue_narrower` call writes a second request and the unchanged-head assertion fails, and the second drain in (c) writes a second one. If findings were not carried or acceptance were copied from the root, the text and bullet assertions fail. Without point 2, (b) ends `ItemEnd::Failed` (drain.rs:1951-1954) with no marker request and the output says `failed twice`. Without the second-generation rule, the unit test queues a request.
demonstrations.seam: `RealSteps::lineage_stop` and `RealSteps::queue_narrower` (added by plan steps 4 and 5) over a real `Athena` and fixture repository (exist); the stop and the request text come from `athena_core::reading::lineage_stop` (step 2) computed from the fixture's own records. The fake agent only plays the rejecting verifier. Nothing under test sits in a double.
